decisions.notes: Realistic brown bear with shaggy golden-brown and dark fur walking on all fours toward the viewer. Hyper-detailed Grab3D animal: glTF validation clean (0 errors), single fused mesh at ~800k triangles with three PBR texture maps (basecolor, normal, roughness/metallic). Upstream lists it as a realistic (non-cartoon) high-detail model. Unrigged static mesh.
limitations: AI-assisted origin is disclosed upstream (origin.ai_content); some storefronts require an AI-content disclosure when you resell.
Unrigged: the walking/standing pose is baked into the mesh, so it cannot be re-posed or animated without adding a skeleton.
Single fused mesh with baked textures; no separate parts to animate.
